name: Hanabishi Miki
source:
Likes: Spending money
Dislikes: Exercising

Miki is the vice-class president of Hayate's class and a part of The Hakuo Three Amiga with Izumi and Risa. Miki has a mischievous nature, especially when it involves Hayate or Hinagiku. She seems to have a crush on Hinagiku and is especially observant of her. She has a laid-back sort of feel, often talking in a lazy voice. Miki also specializes in investigation work, which may be the result of being the daughter of an important government official.

[From [url=http://hayatenogotoku.wikia.com/wiki/Miki_Hanabishi]Hayate no Gotoku Wiki[/url]]
